about_the_game:
Game IntroductionThis game is currently a beta demo and does not represent the final product.

You must gather limited resources (such as food, medicine, weapons, and parts) to survive, using a variety of weapons to battle monsters. Every second you survive in the game is challenging and precious.

High risk often comes with high reward—rare supplies and key plot clues are often hidden in perilous zones, but powerful enemies also lurk there. Will you press forward courageously or proceed with caution? The choice is in your hands. You must carefully decide when to use your resources, as even a small mistake can lead to escalating consequences in the future. Survive at all costs.

Gameplay Flow

The game features a compartmentalized open-world exploration design, with maps gradually unlocking as you progress. Danger zones are hidden in unknown corners, and new chapters can only be unlocked through combat, puzzle-solving, and story-driven dialogues.

Special Mechanics

The game continuously exerts psychological pressure on players through dark, lonely, and eerie scene designs (such as twisted monsters and blood-soaked environments).

Light intensity will dynamically affect your field of vision, and the unknowns in the darkness will constantly test your courage. Numerous events will directly impact your Sanity (SAN) value. When your SAN drops below certain thresholds, different events will be triggered. You must stay alert at all times and avoid being dragged into the abyss of nightmares.

short_description: This game blends Polandball's dark humor with psychological horror and survival combat. Scavenge limited resources (food, medicine, weapons, parts) to stay alive, fend off monsters with diverse arsenals. Every second of survival is a hard-won luxury – survive until you unveil the truth.
